results.description:
Join us for DevFest Abuja 2026, a two-day tech extravaganza on October 30-31! Get hands-on experience with the latest in AI, UI/UX, Cloud & Kubernetes, and Mobile + AI during our immersive workshops at Novare Mall. Then, dive into keynotes and breakout sessions at Aduvie Event Centre to fuel your innovations and network with like-minded individuals.

Take charge of your tech future upskill, discover new opportunities, and become part of Abuja's vibrant tech community. Don’t miss the chance to learn, connect, and grow! Secure your spot now!
